title: Pocketwire Rewards Courtesy Points for Late Gift Card and Charity Fulfilment
content:
Pocketwire Rewards courtesy points are credited only for a gift card or charity redemption that was fulfilled late, and each courtesy credit is booked as one entry against the late redemption.

## When courtesy points are owed

1. Courtesy points are credited only for a gift card or charity redemption that was fulfilled late: its fulfilment was recorded later than the tier's fulfilment time in business days after the redemption date, or it is still unfulfilled and not reversed after that period, the fulfilment period being counted in Federal Reserve business days from the redemption date with the first business day after the redemption as day 1.
2. A courtesy credit is booked as one entry against the late redemption, at most once per late redemption and at most the tier's yearly courtesy limit times over the rolling 365 days.
3. No courtesy points are credited for any other complaint.

## Lateness check (hypothetical tier with a fulfilment time of 1 business day, a week with no Federal Reserve holiday)

| Redemption on | Fulfilment recorded on | Late |
|---|---|---|
| Monday | Tuesday, day 1 | No |
| Monday | Wednesday | Yes |
| Monday | not yet, and not reversed, on the Wednesday | Yes |
| Friday | Monday, day 1 | No |

## Limit check (hypothetical yearly courtesy limit of 2)

| Courtesy credits dated in the rolling 365 days | Another courtesy credit |
|---|---|
| 0 or 1 | can be booked |
| 2 | cannot be booked |

A redemption that already has a courtesy credit entry against it is not credited a second time.

## Crediting tool: credit_late_fulfilment_courtesy_4e426c94

Situation of use and capability. The tool credits Pocketwire Rewards courtesy points for a gift card or charity redemption fulfilled late. It books one courtesy credit entry on the member's points ledger, dated today and linked to the late redemption, and adds the points to the membership's points balance. Courtesy points are available to redeem at once. The member sees the courtesy credit in the app's points activity and a higher points balance straight away.

How it is invoked. `credit_late_fulfilment_courtesy_4e426c94` is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

Parameters.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `membership_id` | the rewards membership reference number of the member being credited, as returned by the rewards membership lookup | reference number |
| `source_txn_id` | the rewards entry reference number of the late gift card or charity redemption being compensated, the redemption entry itself and not its fulfilment entry, as shown by the rewards activity lookup | reference number |
| `points` | the courtesy points credited | a whole integer number of points, zero or positive |

Return. A text rendering of a dictionary with `status` (the text "credited" when the entry was booked), `rewards_entry_id` (reference number of the new points entry), `membership_id`, `source_txn_id` (the compensated redemption), `points` (integer points credited), `entry_date` (booking date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `points_balance` (the membership's integer points balance including this credit).
